text: The Patriots are heading to Jacksonville this Sunday at 1 PM ET to face the Jaguars in Week 3, but they're doing so with some notable roster shuffling following their 20-3 victory over the Steelers. Mike Onwenu, the starting right guard, suffered a broken right ankle in that win and has been placed on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the active roster from the practice squad and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. The defensive performance against Pittsburgh was dominant—particularly in man coverage—though Drake Maye's execution and decision-making remain under the microscope as the Patriots continue to rebuild their offensive identity, with running back TreVeyon Henderson providing a bright spot with a touchdown in the win. Meanwhile, on a lighter note, Patriots legend Adam Vinatieri set a Guinness World Record by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters atop the Jungfraujoch in Switzerland, proving that even in retirement, the GOAT kicker is still making the most improbable kicks.
